mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation pressures ease.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 1300 and 720000 respectively indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 720000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100.0 for two consecutive months during a supply shock regime indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 during supply shocks, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth exceeding 160,000 thousand persons over the past 3 months signals robust labor market conditions, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 160000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits (HOUST) falling below 1300 thousand units over the past month indicates weakening housing demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending contracts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing expansion, supporting corporate capacity utilization and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as borrowing costs pressure corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
